messages:
Maya: Heads-up — noticed onboarding 'progress_tag' isn't backfilling for a subset of imported accounts. Automation didn't run after the last staging deploy. Anyone else seeing failures?
Ajay: Yep, saw errors in the run logs. playbooks-bot flagged a 502 on /workflows/run around 09:42. cc @Samir
Samir: I pulled the logs. Rule matcher crashes when contact.email is null and we try to run a regex. Simple NPE. Patch is just a guard: `if not contact.get('email'): return False`.
Maya: Can we hotfix in prod or do a data rerun? This affects ~2k accounts — renewal nudges won't trigger unless we backfill.
Priya: I recommend we patch + run a sample backfill first. Happy to own the full backfill once sample looks clean.
Ajay: Plan: 1) merge branch cs/fix-guard 2) deploy to staging 3) run `python scripts/backfill_progress.py --sample 0.01` 4) verify results 5) promote to prod. I can merge and queue the deploy.
playbooks-bot: Deployment queued by Ajay: cs/fix-guard -> staging (build #231)
Samir: Backfill command for sample: `python scripts/backfill_progress.py --ids-file sample.csv --dry-run` — run dry-run first. If sample passes, remove `--dry-run` and kick full.
Priya: I'll run the dry-run and verify telemetry. If green I'll trigger full run overnight and add a quick checkpoint doc to the runbook.
Maya: :thumbsup: I'll draft a short note for CS with impacted customer IDs and fallback steps. Owners: Ajay (merge/deploy), Samir (patch review), Priya (backfill).
Ajay: Opening an internal ticket: <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4321|CS-4321> — tagging ops and success-team. Target: patch + sample run by EOD. If we can't get patch in, fallback = disable matcher and send manual nudges.
Maya: Thanks all — please update the ticket with results. I'll notify SRE if the backfill needs extra quota.
